The app is a Unity WebGL build inside a one-route Nuxt shell: the only reachable app code is the /web-demo Nuxt route component (_nuxt/CSNGdBb4.js — the 2026-11-01 re-cut of the same component that was _nuxt/B9hgXP_e.js) — a compiled Vue SFC whose author-facing content is in the template strings while the compiler generated the short top-level bindings.
